sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_from_net_worth" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_net_worth" IN (0, 1)), "credit_limit" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "budget_amount" INTEGER NULL, "budget_period" TEXT NULL, "budget_rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("budget_rollover" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK ((budget_amount IS NULL) = (budget_period IS NULL)), CHECK (budget_amount IS NULL OR budget_amount > 0), CHECK (budget_amount IS NULL OR kind = 'expense'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES category_groups (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "budget_amount" INTEGER NULL, "budget_period" TEXT NULL, "budget_rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("budget_rollover" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK ((budget_amount IS NULL) = (budget_period IS NULL)), CHECK (budget_amount IS NULL OR budget_amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "assets_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_assets_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_amount" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_due_at" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "remaining_occurrences" INTEGER NULL, "auto_post" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_post" IN (0, 1)), "notify" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notify" IN (0, 1)), "is_paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_paused" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type <> 'transfer' OR (to_assets_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_assets_account_id <> assets_account_id AND amount > 0 AND category_id IS NULL AND (to_amount IS NULL OR to_amount > 0))), CHECK (type = 'transfer' OR (to_assets_account_id IS NULL AND to_amount IS NULL)), CHECK (currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), CHECK (type <> 'openingBalance'), CHECK (interval >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "assets_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_assets_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_amount" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange_rate" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "reminder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES reminders (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type <> 'transfer' OR (to_assets_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_assets_account_id <> assets_account_id AND amount > 0 AND category_id IS NULL AND (to_amount IS NULL OR to_amount > 0))), CHECK (type = 'transfer' OR (to_assets_account_id IS NULL AND to_amount IS NULL)), CHECK (currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), CHECK (type = 'transfer' OR exchange_rate IS NULL), CHECK (type <> 'openingBalance' OR category_id IS NULL));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_labels" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES labels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "label_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_labels" ("reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reminders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES labels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("reminder_id", "label_id"));
CREATE INDEX transactions_assets_account_occurred_at ON transactions (assets_account_id, occurred_at)
